name: Webwright
description: Browser agent from Microsoft that gives a coding model a terminal and Playwright sessions and solves each web task as a re-runnable script.
whatItDoes: Webwright completes web tasks such as searches and form flows, producing a single Python script that reproduces the whole run. It suits developers who want repeatable web automations from coding models.
howItWorks: One agent loop works in a terminal, launching browser sessions and inspecting screenshots or page state only when needed, with helper tools for image question answering and self-reflection. YAML configs choose the OpenAI or Anthropic backend.
run: python -m webwright.run.cli -c base.yaml -c model_openai.yaml -t "Search for flights from SEA to JFK on 2026-08-15 to 2026-08-20" --start-url https://www.google.com/flights --task-id demo_openai -o outputs/default
